english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for handing over money, settling an obligation, or paying for a cost.
Use this as the all-purpose colloquial way to say that someone pays or provides money for something.
This is the all-purpose choice when paying or rewarding someone for work.

examples.english: We pay after we finish eating.

examples.english: The company agrees to fund our trip.
